title: Toddler with Towel on Head in Outdoor Playpen, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot from June 1956 featuring a young toddler standing inside a wooden crib or playpen set out on a grassy lawn. The child playfully covers their head with a towel, dressed in patterned shorts or swim trunks. The background features an open yard with a low block wall and a small tree, typical of mid-century American suburban life and outdoor play during warm summer months.
